summary: The terminal UI reads each attention row's presentation (Now group, card, chat agent, raiser, held step) instead of deriving it

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites; no contract change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Upgrade daemons before clients. The terminal UI reads Attention.presentation (presentation capability, version 1). A row without one (an older daemon, or a row st has not presented yet) shows st's text as an unplaced card under somebody is stopped on you when st marks it an alert and when there is time otherwise, saying st does not say what it is and to answer it with st alerts; it offers no answer of its own, and a message or fault stays off Now. A group or card a newer daemon names that this client does not know shows the same way instead of being dropped. The raiser now reads as st labels it: an agent as label · id, every daemon actor as st.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator actions, client re-pairing or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or swap-back restrictions.
